headline: Standard Chartered Lifts Full-Year Targets as Q3 Net Profit Climbs 46% to $1.5B
summary: Standard Chartered raised its full-year guidance after third-quarter net profit increased 46% year-on-year to $1.5 billion, driven by robust performance in cross-border trade loans and wealth management.
why: Standard Chartered is an internationally systemically important bank headquartered in London with significant business exposure across Asia, Africa, and the Middle East.

impacts.name: Standard Chartered PLC
impacts.why: Operating earnings beat consensus estimates by wide margins and triggered an upward revision of full-year corporate targets.

why_moved: Shares and sentiment improved after net profit rose 46% to $1.5 billion, comfortably beating analysts' expectations on strong trade and wealth management gains.
